records.key: How many times larger than the canvas the box draws its region. The mouse wheel changes it while the magnifier is on. It changes only what you see: the model always segments the region at the image's own resolution.
records.source: How many times larger than the canvas the box draws its region. The mouse wheel changes it while the magnifier is on. It changes only what you see: the model always segments the region at the image's own resolution.
records.translation: Cuántas veces más grande que el lienzo dibuja el recuadro su región. La rueda del ratón lo cambia mientras la lupa está activada. Solo cambia lo que ve: el modelo siempre segmenta la región con la resolución propia de la imagen.

records.key: How readily an object is accepted. Raise it to take in dimmer or less certain objects, lower it to keep only clear ones; 0 is each model's own default. For Cellpose it is the cell probability threshold with the sign reversed, so a sensitivity of 1.5 is a threshold of -1.5.
records.source: How readily an object is accepted. Raise it to take in dimmer or less certain objects, lower it to keep only clear ones; 0 is each model's own default. For Cellpose it is the cell probability threshold with the sign reversed, so a sensitivity of 1.5 is a threshold of -1.5.
records.translation: Con qué facilidad se acepta un objeto. Súbala para incluir objetos más tenues o menos seguros, bájela para quedarse solo con los claros; 0 es el valor predeterminado de cada modelo. Para Cellpose es el umbral de probabilidad de célula con el signo invertido, así que una sensibilidad de 1.5 equivale a un umbral de -1.5.

records.key: Magnifier off. The objects it added stay in the mask.
records.source: Magnifier off. The objects it added stay in the mask.
records.translation: Lupa desactivada. Los objetos que añadió permanecen en la máscara.

records.key: Magnifier on: a click adds the objects outlined in the box; the mouse wheel changes its zoom.
records.source: Magnifier on: a click adds the objects outlined in the box; the mouse wheel changes its zoom.
records.translation: Lupa activada: un clic añade los objetos delineados en el recuadro; la rueda del ratón cambia su zoom.

records.key: Magnifier: nothing to add — the box outlines no object, or every object it outlines overlaps one already in the mask.
records.source: Magnifier: nothing to add — the box outlines no object, or every object it outlines overlaps one already in the mask.
records.translation: Lupa: nada que añadir — el recuadro no delinea ningún objeto, o cada objeto que delinea se superpone con uno que ya está en la máscara.

records.key: Segments the region under the mouse. A click adds the objects the box outlines to the mask.
records.source: Segments the region under the mouse. A click adds the objects the box outlines to the mask.
records.translation: Segmenta la región bajo el ratón. Un clic añade a la máscara los objetos que delinea el recuadro.

records.key: Show a box under the mouse with the region around it magnified and the objects a model finds in it outlined, live. A click adds the outlined objects to the mask as new objects, one undo step per click. While it is on, the mouse wheel changes the box's zoom rather than the view's.
records.source: Show a box under the mouse with the region around it magnified and the objects a model finds in it outlined, live. A click adds the outlined objects to the mask as new objects, one undo step per click. While it is on, the mouse wheel changes the box's zoom rather than the view's.
records.translation: Muestra bajo el ratón un recuadro con la región circundante ampliada y, en directo, los objetos que un modelo encuentra en ella delineados. Un clic añade los objetos delineados a la máscara como objetos nuevos, un paso de deshacer por clic. Mientras está activada, la rueda del ratón cambia el zoom del recuadro en lugar del de la vista.

records.key: Side of the square region the model segments, in image pixels. Objects cut by the edge of the box are not offered, so make it wider than the largest object you want to add.
records.source: Side of the square region the model segments, in image pixels. Objects cut by the edge of the box are not offered, so make it wider than the largest object you want to add.
records.translation: Lado de la región cuadrada que segmenta el modelo, en píxeles de imagen. Los objetos cortados por el borde del recuadro no se ofrecen, así que hágalo más ancho que el objeto más grande que quiera añadir.

records.key: What a new object does where the mask already has an object. Clip keeps only its unlabelled pixels, so no existing object loses a pixel. Skip leaves out any object that touches an existing one. Replace lets the new object take every pixel it covers.
records.source: What a new object does where the mask already has an object. Clip keeps only its unlabelled pixels, so no existing object loses a pixel. Skip leaves out any object that touches an existing one. Replace lets the new object take every pixel it covers.
records.translation: Qué hace un objeto nuevo donde la máscara ya tiene un objeto. Recortar conserva solo sus píxeles sin etiquetar, así que ningún objeto existente pierde un píxel. Omitir deja fuera cualquier objeto que toque uno existente. Reemplazar deja que el objeto nuevo tome todos los píxeles que cubre.

records.key: Which model segments the region in the box. Classical thresholds the region at Otsu's level and splits touching objects with a watershed; it needs nothing installed, follows the Bright switch and the Min area box under Object operations, and runs whenever a model cannot be loaded. Cellpose uses the model and diameter set in the Cellpose-SAM settings and is slow without a GPU.
records.source: Which model segments the region in the box. Classical thresholds the region at Otsu's level and splits touching objects with a watershed; it needs nothing installed, follows the Bright switch and the Min area box under Object operations, and runs whenever a model cannot be loaded. Cellpose uses the model and diameter set in the Cellpose-SAM settings and is slow without a GPU.
records.translation: Qué modelo segmenta la región del recuadro. Clásico umbraliza la región al nivel de Otsu y separa los objetos que se tocan con una divisoria de aguas; no necesita nada instalado, sigue el interruptor Brillante y la casilla Min area de Operaciones de objetos, y se ejecuta siempre que no se puede cargar un modelo. Cellpose usa el modelo y el diámetro fijados en los ajustes de Cellpose-SAM y es lento sin GPU.
